title: Implement binary search variants in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement binary_search (returns index or -1), lower_bound (first index >= target), upper_bound (first index > target), and search_range (first and last occurrence as a tuple).

injections.content: # TODO: implement binary_search, lower_bound, upper_bound, search_range

from src.binary_search import binary_search, lower_bound, upper_bound, search_range


def test_binary_search():
    arr = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
    assert binary_search(arr, 5) == 2
    assert binary_search(arr, 4) == -1
    assert binary_search(arr, 1) == 0


def test_lower_bound():
    arr = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
    assert lower_bound(arr, 4) == 2
    assert lower_bound(arr, 5) == 2
    assert lower_bound(arr, 10) == 5


def test_upper_bound():
    arr = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
    assert upper_bound(arr, 5) == 3
    assert upper_bound(arr, 9) == 5


def test_search_range():
    arr = [1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 5]
    assert search_range(arr, 2) == (1, 3)
    assert search_range(arr, 4) == (-1, -1)


def test_empty():
    assert binary_search([], 5) == -1
    assert lower_bound([], 5) == 0
    assert search_range([], 5) == (-1, -1)
